input.text: A controller shall comply with sections 9815 and 9816 of this title.

_note: resolver : proves host_section_numbers is threaded through clause_cue_contributions() itself (not only cross_reference_links()/resolve_references() called directly). With a KNOWN but non-matching host_section_numbers set ({'1234'}), neither member of 'sections 9815 and 9816' is in the file, so the whole plural chain is ONE EXTERNAL reference ('all_out' branch) -> structural=1. If clause_cue_contributions() silently dropped host_section_numbers to None internally, the resolver cannot distinguish 'known not in file' from 'unknown', falls into the mixed-split branch, and splits the SAME text into TWO separate EXTERNAL references -> structural=2 -- a different raw count for the identical input. Numbers invented, not drawn from any gold/dev extract.
